🔒 Nothing you type leaves your device. Your text is only kept in this browser, so it's still here if you switch apps.

Tap and hold in the box → Paste, then tap Make my letters.

1 In your AI chat, click Copy on the box with the letter. No box? Send the AI: Put everything in one code block.
2 Paste it below and click Make my letters.
3 Check the preview, then click Print / Save as PDF.
✨ Magic extras:
Printing: choose Actual size / 100% and turn on Background graphics (in the printer dialog, under More settings). To get a PDF file, pick Save as PDF as the printer. Cardstock is lovely for the Nice List and the notes. Envelope: fold the letter in three, lay the envelope sheet face down, put the letter on the middle panel, fold the bottom up and the top down, and close it with a sticker. Santa’s voice: the QR code on the letter and the Nice List plays a short recorded message from Santa (the same for every child). Scan it with your phone before you print. Writing it yourself? Click Show an example and change the words in the box: everything after body: is the letter.
